channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLpolitics, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Republican Economic Confidence Drops Sharply
item.description: Republican confidence in the economy has fallen rapidly over six months, a decline not seen since the pandemic and reminiscent of the Great Recession.

item.title: GOP accepts Trump's self-focused midterm approach
item.description: As President Trump campaigns, Republicans worry his focus on himself may hurt their chances in the upcoming midterms.

item.title: U.S. strikes three Iranian tankers in retaliation
item.description: After Iran fired missiles at U.S. warships, American forces hit three Iranian oil tankers, according to Central Command.

item.title: Expensive summer finale approaches
item.description: High gas and food prices are making the end-of-summer holiday more costly for many Americans.
